title: El Metro offers free bus rides today for H-E-B's Feast of Sharing in Laredo
excerpt: El Metro will run free bus rides on all routes today, Wednesday, Nov. 4, from 3 p.m. to 10 p.m. for H-E-B's 38th Annual Feast of Sharing Holiday Dinner, according to Texas Border Business.
content:
El Metro Transit System will provide free bus rides on all routes in Laredo on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, from 3 p.m. to 10 p.m., according to Texas Border Business.

The free rides coincide with H-E-B's 38th Annual Feast of Sharing Holiday Dinner, which runs from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. at Sames Auto Arena, 6700 Arena Blvd., according to Texas Border Business. The dinner is free and open to the public.

The free-ride window starts one hour before the dinner begins and continues for two hours after it ends, giving attendees extra time to travel to and from the event, according to Texas Border Business.

The offer applies to all El Metro routes during the seven-hour period, not only to routes serving the arena, according to Texas Border Business. Riders are encouraged to review routes and schedules in advance and to allow enough time for their return trips.

Sources:

  • Texas Border Business, "El Metro Offers Free Bus Rides for H-E-B's 38th Annual Feast of Sharing in Laredo," November 4, 2026
